summary: Remora Capital Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated investment sub-advisory agreement with Crescent Capital Group LP and Remora Capital Management, LLC, effective October 15, 2026. The amendment only limits Crescent's advisory responsibilities to defined Sub-Advised Assets and restricts consultation with other sub-advisers to satisfy Rule 17a-10 and Rule 12d3-1 under the 1940 Act. Fees and a two-year term from September 5, 2025 remain unchanged, with annual board and disinterested-director approval. This is a routine advisory contract amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms, no arbitrage angle.
